title: data/campaigns.json
description: Named campaigns, from ATT&CK and, later, from report write-ups.

last_seen.description: Null while the campaign is ongoing or the source gives no end.

actors.description: Resolved actors the source attributes the campaign to.

campaignId.description: The ATT&CK campaign ID, such as C0022, or a source-scoped ID.

actorId.description: An ATT&CK group ID such as G0007, or a lower-case ASCII slug for an actor ATT&CK does not track. The ID is also the actor's file name and URL segment, so it has no colons, slashes or spaces, and it is never 'index'.

label.description: Non-empty text with no leading or trailing whitespace and no line breaks.

nullableDate.description: A date, or null when none is known.

sourceKey.description: A connector key such as attack or misp, as listed in sources.json. Never a display name.

techniqueId.description: An ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID.
